scope: owner daemon IPC and disposable container; no installed Desktop or household data

command: python3 -c 'import json,pathlib; p=pathlib.Path("/workspace/household"); a=json.loads((p/"pantry.json").read_text()); b=json.loads((p/"meal-plan.json").read_text()); out={k:v-a.get(k,0) for k,v in b.items() if v>a.get(k,0)}; pathlib.Path("/workspace/shopping-list.json").write_text(json.dumps(out))'

limitations: Scripted model decisions; not an autonomous result.
Owner worker uses injected container Bash, not household host Bash.
Result readback shares a trusted container; response semantics are unassessed.
A client acknowledgement is not proof of human delivery.
